continuity compiler projecting prior scores, open/rejected recommendations, decisions, and prior run pins into ContinuityPacket for IntelligenceRunRequest
website collection with credential, scheme, port, DNS/IP, redirect, fetch-target, response-size, content-type, content-encoding and absolute wall-clock deadline controls, including DNS time

single-channel one-call fast path and bounded runs of up to eight channels with provider concurrency capped at three
one bounded cross-channel synthesis and at most one formatting/schema correction across malformed JSON and typed validation paths
attempt telemetry counted before initial and correction calls, including failed attempts
exact channel and synthesis cache keys covering projected context, evidence identity/freshness, prior state and pinned model contract versions
atomic private JSON stage/cache implementations with bounded reads/writes plus injectable persistence protocols
successful stage and cache loads revalidated before reuse, successful siblings persisted, and synthesis retry resumed
typed finding, recommendation, context-proposal and synthesis validation with evidence-reference integrity

optional pinned prior scores/result, deterministic score deltas and named evidence, brief/lens, methodology or correction causes

assumed_db_contracts.source: kernel branch feat/alm-intelligence-v1-kernel migration 20260723020611_alm_intelligence_kernel.sql (not present in this worktree)

service_role_rpcs.upsert_evidence: (p_items jsonb) → setof uuid — fields: subject_id, channel_id, snapshot_id, source_type, source_url, observed_at, expires_at, content_hash, confidence, coverage, payload; ON CONFLICT (subject_id, content_hash) DO NOTHING
service_role_rpcs.start_intelligence_run: (p_subject_id, p_brief_version, p_evidence_snapshot_id, p_methodology_version, p_expertise_pack_version, p_prompt_version, p_model_config_hash, p_output_schema_version, p_batch_id) → uuid
service_role_rpcs.record_scores: (p_scores jsonb) — fields: run_id, dimension, value, evidence_ids, methodology_version; table also has previous_value, change_kind (runtime emits both; current RPC may ignore extras until kernel extends insert)
service_role_rpcs.record_findings: (p_findings jsonb) — fields: run_id, finding_ref, claim, evidence_ids, confidence, dimension_impacts, channel_type
service_role_rpcs.record_recommendations: (p_recommendations jsonb) — fields: run_id, recommendation_ref, content, evidence_ids, channel_type
service_role_rpcs.create_context_update_proposals: (p_proposals jsonb) → setof uuid — fields: subject_id, base_version, intelligence_run_id, path, operation, proposed_value, evidence_ids, reason
service_role_rpcs.finalize_intelligence_run: (p_run_id, p_status, p_latency_ms, p_tokens_in, p_tokens_out, p_cost_usd, p_cache_mode)

assumed_db_contracts.evidence_id_mapping: Contract evidence_id is UUIDv5(content_hash). Kernel evidence.id is DB-generated. Findings/scores store contract evidence_id strings; row identity/reuse is (subject_id, content_hash).
assumed_db_contracts.not_wired_in_this_branch: No supabase_client.py / pipeline.py binding — LedgerWriter and StageStore/AnalysisCache protocols remain injectable for release integration.

verification.command: cd worker && uv run pytest tests/test_intelligence_continuity_ledger.py tests/test_intelligence_contracts.py tests/test_intelligence_inference.py tests/test_intelligence_runtime.py tests/test_intelligence_website.py tests/test_intelligence_adversarial.py -q

blockers: Kernel migration not present in this worktree — release must merge kernel before binding LedgerWriter to Supabase service-role RPCs.

record_scores RPC currently inserts only run_id/dimension/value/evidence_ids/methodology_version; scores.previous_value and scores.change_kind are emitted by runtime and need a kernel RPC extension (or direct insert) before those columns are populated.
No pipeline/generation wiring in this branch by ownership — release integrates BoundedIntelligenceRuntime behind compatibility boundaries.
No live provider or public-network benchmark in this worktree by contract.

release_handoff.integration_note: Bind LedgerWriter to service-role RPCs listed in assumed_db_contracts; bind StageStore/AnalysisCache to intelligence_runs.stage_state or durable storage; route subject homes via ensure_subject_home(subject_id); keep Hermes scratch subordinate to ledger.
risks: Website collection intentionally uses one pre-approved DNS address and does not fail over across answers, favoring SSRF determinism over availability.
The strict intelligence adapter owns a dedicated non-streaming Hermes wire path so empty toolsets and stateless headers are explicit without changing the legacy report client's behavior.
